formats.name: Crispy tofu ASMR, top-down
formats.summary: Overhead pan shot, loud sizzle, no talking. Text hook promises speed.

why.hook: The first words on screen, "Crispy tofu in 5 min", tell people exactly what they will get, and fast.
why.first3s: Tofu hits hot oil straight away. The loud sizzle makes people stop and watch.
why.length: Only about 13 seconds, so many people watch it twice. The app treats that as a sign the video is good.
why.format: One camera filming from above. No face and no talking, so anyone can film it.
why.sound: Just the real cooking sound, turned up loud. No music.

shotList.shot: Top-down: tofu cubes drop into hot oil
Close-up: cubes turning golden, tongs flipping
Sauce poured over, quick toss in the pan
Plated, one piece pulled apart to show the crunch

formats.editorNotes: Keep the sizzle loud. Cut on each flip. Text hook in the first frame, large and centred.
